paragraphs.source_en: When Matsudaira Motoyasu clasped Sena-hime tightly in his arms, she gently closed her eyes. paragraphs.source_en: Motoyasu began to wonder whether his sentimentality sprang from weakness of heart. Sena-hime was sorrowful, but was he himself any less so?
